### Universe screen (crypto)

13 assets, 2016-01-01 → 2026-05-23; 51 pairs pass the correlation prefilter (≥ 0.5); 8 of them reject the Engle-Granger null at 5%. With 78 candidate pairs, ≈ 4 would pass at 5% by pure chance (Clegg 2014), so this screen is *descriptive*: performance claims come only from the walk-forward section below.
